contract.goal: a request's validated delegation claim (act.sub, configurable) is recorded as Actor.via on every audit event, searchable as via on the audit trail, and optionally required of USER principals on the administrative surface, as specified in specs/admin-authorization, audit-envelope, audit-trail-search
contract.output: Actor.via (factories unchanged); Delegation on LudwigAuthentication; DelegationClaims; ludwig.security.jwt.actor-claim; PrincipalActorResolver fills via; ludwig.admin.human-callers.required-via in AdminSurfaceGuard; audit 0006-actor-via.sql + entity + via filter; revapi entry; READMEs EN+RU of three modules; admin guide EN+RU; OpenAPI docs regenerated; follow-ups
constraints: no POM structure changes (revapi entry only)
roles never from claims: act grants no authority
only a validated token's claim counts, never a header
required-via applies to USER principals only
done_when: mvn -pl :audit-core,:security-spring-boot-starter,:audit-spring-boot-starter + every in-repo dependent -am verify (one reactor install)

The refusal goes through a new AdminAccessEvaluator.refuse(authentication, handler, message) - authorize() now calls it - so it is published as an AuthorizationDeniedEvent and audited/metered like every denial.
